create_checkout_session amount validation: PRODUCTS dict trusts Python config but no Pydantic enum on product_key. Currently 400-handled, acceptable.
Stripe status fetch falls back to DB on failure (logged warning) — good resilience pattern. Make sure webhook is the source of truth in production.
Subscription Price IDs intentionally empty — confirmed graceful 503. Once Stripe Dashboard Price IDs are minted, restart backend to pick up env vars.
Frontend SuccessPage: MAX_ATTEMPTS=12 × 2.5s = 30s polling window. Adequate for Stripe Checkout completion latency. Webhook should mark txn paid before user lands on /success in real flow.
